description:
CK model health monitoring with Microsoft Teams alerting.

Installs a cron pipeline (hourly) that reads
{tenantId}/v1/Models/LibraryStatus for every configured MonitoredTenant and
posts an alert to a Teams incoming webhook when an installed CK model is in
state ResolveFailed (its types are not loaded and dependent pipelines fail)
or has a catalog inconsistency. Tenants whose check request fails
(unreachable, auth error) are alerted too - one dead tenant never hides the
others.

Install this blueprint into a HEALTHY operations tenant, not into the
tenants being watched, so the watchdog does not share fate with its patient.
Cross-tenant reads work because client-credentials tokens bypass the
allowed_tenants check.

Post-install steps:
  1. Edit the "CK Health Monitor Configuration" entity: TokenUrl,
     AssetServicesBaseUrl (no trailing slash), ClientId/ClientSecret of a
     service client with asset read access, Scope (octo_api),
     TeamsWebhookUrl.
  2. Edit/add "Monitored Tenant" entities (attribute TenantId), one per
     tenant to watch.
  3. Deploy the DataFlow and activate the trigger:
     octo-cli -c DeployDataFlow --identifier 0c4ea1000000000000000001
     octo-cli -c DeployTriggers
  4. Smoke test without waiting for the cron:
     octo-cli -c ExecutePipeline --identifier 0c4ea1000000000000000002

Notes: a force re-apply (InstallBlueprint -f) resets the configuration
entities to their placeholders - reconfigure afterwards. Alerts repeat on
every run until the condition is fixed (intentional). If the token endpoint
itself is down, the execution fails visibly but no Teams alert is sent.
